{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

duplicate_count = len(duplicates)
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {duplicate_count}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_final
missing_baseline_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {missing_baseline_count}")

# Check assay_batch values
batch_values = df['assay_batch'].unique()
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {batch_values}")

# Check if any biomarker_final values are -999
missing_final_count = (df['biomarker_final'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_final: {missing_final_count}")"}
